breaking.change: Removed. The UI's actions (confirm, back, tabNext, tabPrev, details, rotate) are og-input actions in the `ui` action map, defined in every world and live behind the maps og.input.setActionMaps names, so a game's own actions win a shared key there. The player rebinds them with og.input.rebind as any action. og.input's action map, which is world state, now holds them, so every world's hash changes once.
breaking.fix: Define or redefine a UI action with og.input.defineAction(world, { name, actionMap: "ui", bindings: [{ control: "Enter" }, { control: "pad.a" }] }): each key is a binding's control, and a pad button is `pad.<button>`. A hold is holdMs with toggle. A release trigger reads og.input.isActionJustReleased. An action that followed a gameplay action (`action`) is that action: read it directly.

breaking.change: Removed with og.ui's actions: the UI actions are og-input's.
breaking.fix: Read og.input.isActionJustPressed(world, name) where og.ui.actionFired(name) was, and og.input.isActionLongPressed(world, name) where og.ui.actionHeld(name) was. Both take the world, which a system has.

breaking.change: Removed: og.input.glyph answers every action's glyph, the UI's included, on the device used last, as an InputGlyph (icon, text, device, and the control it names). A `<Glyph action>` in TSX shows it and follows a rebinding on the next frame.
breaking.fix: Call og.input.glyph(world, action) where og.ui.glyph(world, action) was. Where og.ui.frameGlyph(action) was, pass the world: og.input.glyph(world, action), or show a `<Glyph action>`.

breaking.change: Removed: og.input.device answers the device the player used last, as an InputDevice with the same values.
breaking.fix: Call og.input.device(world) where og.ui.device(world) was; write InputDevice where UiDevice was.

breaking.change: Removed, with no replacement: og-input tracks the device used last from the input itself, and a pad's family from the pad the host reports (og.input.padDevice). A game can no longer force the device or the pad family that prompts show.
breaking.fix: Delete the call. Prompts follow the device the player uses.
